data.one_liner: A Flutter carousel with ten composable effects, autoplay, indicators, and accessibility.
data.what_it_does: Shows a row or column of items one page at a time with built-in dragging, keyboard navigation, screen-reader support, and lifecycle-aware autoplay. Supports fixed-size items and content-sized expandable pages.
use_when: You need a customizable carousel or slider with advanced animation effects
You require accessibility features like screen-reader support and keyboard navigation
You need autoplay that pauses on touch, hover, or when out of focus
avoid_when: You are using a version of Flutter older than 3.47
You need a simple page view without any carousel styling or indicators
strengths: Ten composable effects and custom effect builder support
Zero third-party dependencies, importing widgets.dart only
Built-in accessibility, screen reader, and keyboard navigation support

alternatives.name: carousel_slider
alternatives.why_pick_it: A classic carousel package for Flutter with a long history of usage.
